def example_slice():

    roi = frame[-40:160, -20:180]
    assert roi.shape == (40, 20, 3)

import numpy as np

def binary_samples():
    samples = np.arange(12).reshape(4, 3)
    labels = np.array([0, 2, 1, 3])
    indices = np.where((labels == 0) | (labels == 1))
    return samples[indices], labels[indices]
notes: 元组索引为合法 NumPy 用法；写法偏好不是故障。
